svg.title: Spinal cord or root: upper motor neuron signs below a sensory level mean the cord, and which tracts are lost (corticospinal, spinothalamic, dorsal columns) sorts anterior, posterior, central and Brown-Sequard cord syndromes; a lower motor neuron pattern means the roots, either cauda equina (an emergency) or a single radiculopathy; each column gives the tracts hit, the presentation and the causes

svg.text: Cord causes: not just trauma or tumour

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • vascular: stroke, AVM, fistula · infectious: epidural abscess, viral, syphilis (tabes dorsalis)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • trauma: fracture, stab, disc, radiation · autoimmune: lupus · metabolic: B12 (subacute combined degeneration)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • inflammatory: multiple sclerosis · also: transverse myelitis, syrinx · neoplastic: metastatic, extradural, intrinsic

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • congenital: achondroplasia · degenerative: disc herniation, arthritis, motor neuron disease (ALS)
